column1: # allowed.tsv: the complete list of gmpf calls HbProjector may send on the Z9X HB (goat_elegant). Read by
# tools/devices/check_aidl_hal.py (hal_allowed in devices/goat_elegant/device.conf, rule 6): every Call of
# apps/HbProjector AidlCaller.java must be a row here and every row a Call. Source: the design notes
# (the allow rows: the Java method it serves and the Z9X code it replaces) plus the two meta calls. REVIEW rows of
# banned.tsv (generateLogoByTrapezoid, uiHeartBeatSet / uiHeartBeatDo, getBootReason) are not here: they stay
# refused until approved. newAutoKst was approved on
# 2026-10-29 (9.1): EXCEPTION row of banned.tsv, mode 9, 10 or 11 only (GmpfClient refuses the rest); mode 12 added hb-t7
# (2026-10-30: the stock fit-to-screen hint window "Continue", AuxiliaryCurtainAlignDialog).
# hb-t5 (test of hb-t4, 2026-10-29: no optical zoom, no way back after "Fit to screen"): setKstPrepare is an
# EXCEPTION row for type 2 only (9.3, zoom case); 63 / 95 (optical zoom) and 38 / 84 / 85 (stock keystone reset, 9.7)
# are not banned rows. Every value is restricted in GmpfClient / Gmpf2Client; stock G0130 callers in the reasons.
# '-' as service = meta call, valid on any interface.
